title: Audit a Merged Manifest
prompt: Create a manifest-and-resources audit for a Notes app with one launcher activity, a debug application ID suffix, default strings, and one locale alternative.
successCriteria: Every exported component has a documented reason.
Namespace and both variant application IDs are recorded.
All alternative string resources have defaults with compatible formatting arguments.
hints: Begin with one executable scenario that demonstrates: Every exported component has a documented reason.
Use lifecycle or boundary evidence to prove: Namespace and both variant application IDs are recorded.
solutionOutline: Implement the smallest design that guarantees: Every exported component has a documented reason.
Implement the smallest design that guarantees: Namespace and both variant application IDs are recorded.
Implement the smallest design that guarantees: All alternative string resources have defaults with compatible formatting arguments.
verification: Run a focused check demonstrating that every exported component has a documented reason.
Run a focused check demonstrating that namespace and both variant application IDs are recorded.
Run a focused check demonstrating that all alternative string resources have defaults with compatible formatting arguments.
